title: AweSkillFrontmatter
description: Canonical YAML frontmatter shape for SKILL.md files in the awe skills system. Validators (the Phase 1 `awe-core skill validate` subcommand, the `awehq/community` CI workflow) MUST exit non-zero when a SKILL.md frontmatter fails this schema.

name.description: Kebab-case slug. MUST match the parent directory name. Used as the unique key in skills_registry.

description.description: One-sentence summary, no period at end. Rendered in catalog lists, slash menus, and `awe-core skill list`.

version.description: Semver. Required for catalog tracking (catalog upgrades compare versions); inferred as 1.0.0 by the migrator if absent on hand-written skills.

kind.description: workflow = traditional awe skill (trigger_phrases, stopping_points, actions). subagent = persona delegated to via Task tool (skills/agents/<category>/<name>/). The two kinds have different schema requirements (see allOf below).

required_tools.description: Array of '<server>' or '<server>.<tool>' strings. Server-only declares a hard dependency on the server being present; the dotted form pins a specific tool. Empty [] explicitly = pure markdown skill (no MCP needed).

trigger_phrases.description: Phrases that auto-populate intent_mappings rows on `awe-core skill sync`. Source `auto-skill-trigger`, priority 40. User-curated rows at priority 80+ override these.

stopping_points.description: Workflow contract: required = MUST hit at least one numbered menu before completing. optional = stops are present but completion-without-stop is acceptable. none = run-to-completion (research, summary, etc.).

actions.description: Declares whether the skill HAS structured workflow JSON, not which file is 'official'. Per §0.7c, inline AGENT_ACTIONS in SKILL.md is the canonical authoring source; actions.json is auto-generated cache. inline = AGENT_ACTIONS HTML comments in body (canonical). actions.json = sidecar-only (legacy/imported). none = pure markdown.

imported_from.description: Provenance tracking for non-hand-written skills. Required for any skill that came from an external source.

source.description: Origin of the skill. hand-written = authored directly in this repo.

upstream_id.description: Source-specific identifier. e.g. for Hermes: '@cocal/google-calendar-mcp'. for Claude Code: filename. for catalog: catalog entry id.

upstream_sha.description: sha256 of upstream content at import time. Used by `awe-core skill diff` to surface upstream changes.

upstream_url.description: Link back to upstream source for fork-and-adjust workflow.

metadata.description: Open-ended container for adapter-specific or convention-specific keys.

awe.description: awe-specific metadata. Keys here are recognized by the loader and tooling. Open-ended — adapter mappings (e.g. metadata.awe.tags from Hermes imports) land here without breaking the canonical schema.

config.description: gateway_settings keys to inject at skill load. e.g. ['api_endpoint', 'default_model'].

platforms.description: Platform compat filter. Skills filtered out of catalog index on incompatible platforms.

deprecated_by.description: Pointer to the replacement skill name.

preservation_reason.description: Audit trail for §0.1 preservation list entries (e.g. 'user-preserved 2026-04-25').

persona_role.description: Subagent kind only: short role description (e.g. 'experiment tracker', 'pitch coach').

preferred_tools.description: Subagent kind only: tool names the subagent prefers (e.g. ['Read', 'Write', 'Bash']).

preferred_model.description: Optional preferred model when invoked (e.g. 'sonnet'). Honored by adapters; not enforced by the runtime.

then.description: workflow kind requires the full routing + workflow contract.
